title: Book Two · Chapter 47: Room for the Big Book
story:
On Friday, Ronan starts with the right side of the desk. There are four checked books there. He looks inside each front cover.

No book cards.

He carries the books to the shelf. The smallest goes beside the other short stories. Two picture books fit in the middle space.

The last book is much larger. It is about trains. Its repaired page is still firm.

Ronan stands it up at first. The top touches the shelf above. It leans forward and hides the smaller books.

He takes it down again.

Jun put another large book flat on Wednesday. Ronan tries that place. The train book fits below it. But now only a blue edge shows.

A child comes to look for the station picture.

“Is the train book here?”

Ronan pulls it out.

“Here.”

“I couldn't find it.”

Ronan looks at the narrow blue edge. He can find the book now. The next child may not.

He finds a clean scrap of card. Ronan writes a small label. It says TRAIN BOOK. Then he takes it to Mei.

“Can this stand beside the book?”

Mei reads the words.

“It is clear. Ask Miss Wu about the place.”

Miss Wu is helping a child with the number work. Ronan waits beside her desk. He holds the card down by his leg.

She looks up after a minute.

He shows her the flat books and the small sign.

“Can I leave this here? It points to the train book.”

“Yes. Keep it clear of the path.”

Ronan adds a dark arrow to the label. He puts it just under the book's corner. The title stays above the shelf edge.

The child comes back after a little while. He sees the card at once. He finds the train book and opens it on the low table.

Ronan does not need to pull anything out for him.

At the end of the morning, Miss Wu asks for that book. Jun points to the new sign. Ronan takes the book to the front.

Miss Wu opens to the station picture. The whole class can see it from their desks.

“Thank you,” she says. “Please leave the sign there for next time.”

Ronan goes back to his seat. He looks toward the card desk. Mei is keeping the names today. His job is still the shelf.

At break, Jun asks to read the train page with him. They sit at the low table together. Ronan lets Jun choose the first part.

After school, Ronan tells Dad about the small sign.

“Did you find the train?” Dad asks.

“Everyone can find it now.”

Dad smiles. He is home for a short meal before another job at the counter. The brown box is still there with Mr Sun.

“The woman comes tomorrow,” Dad says.

“May I come?”

“Mum can bring you in the morning.”

Ronan looks at Mum. She nods and asks him to bring the bowls. He puts his school bag by the bed. Then he carries the bowls to the table.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

flat＝平放的；label＝标签；edge＝边缘；shelf＝架子。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样安排大书，让小书更容易找？
2. 老师怎样实际用到了他的整理结果？

## 读句子

**Ronan / writes / a small label.** Ronan／写下／一张小标签。
